description: Get the full details of one data model by id or slug: complete field definitions (type, options, relations, validation) the product capability config (enabled, field roles incl. the resolved `roles`, variantAxes) and the accounts config (`auth`: identityField, companyField/companyRoleField). Use before update_model and when the user asks about a model's structure.

idOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug (from list_models)

name: get_model
